newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Q1 imports estimated at A$19.4 bln-ABS.
newsitem.headline: Australian Q1 imports estimated at A$19.4 bln-ABS.

text.p: The Australian Bureau of Statistics said imports of goods using quarterly seasonal adjustment factors fell to A$19.4 billion in the March quarter from A$19.6 billion in the December quarter.

In its Balance of Goods and Services data for March the ABS noted the sum of the monthly imports figures for the quarter was A$20.2 billion. But using previously released forward quarterly seasonal factors gave a result of A$19.4 billion.
Unless significant revision to the original data were identified, these quarterly results would be incorporated in the March quarter Balance of Payments out on May 30, it said.
